document: GOLD-001 batch 007 — preregistered fixes E/F/G implemented; calibration pilot BLOCKED
status: FIXES IMPLEMENTED AND VERIFIED — PILOT NOT RUN — STOPPED FOR INDEPENDENT REVIEW

fixes_implemented.defect: cross-library duplicate facts are invisible to duplicate control
fixes_implemented.behaviour: compares the normalised (subject, relation, object) triple in addition to text and offsets; flags, never drops; reports 'not_comparable' when no triple can be read
fixes_implemented.verified_against: the real GOLD-B005-11 / GOLD-B006-06 pair the owner caught

fixes_implemented.defect: compound single-span facts are labelled by their first verb
fixes_implemented.behaviour: classifies from the whole sentence; lifecycle first whatever the verb; configuration_interaction requires an interaction verb, so one requirement naming two identifiers is a lookup
fixes_implemented.verified_against: all nine batch-006 candidates against the owner's labels

fixes_implemented.defect: questions inherit the breadth of their frame, not of their evidence
fixes_implemented.behaviour: a scope qualifier in the evidence must appear in the question AND in the critical strings, else the candidate does not export; a comparative aside is not a scope
fixes_implemented.verified_against: the three rescoped candidates as generated and as approved

finding_for_reviewer.detail: The preregistered rule requires the scope qualifier in the question AND in the critical strings. GOLD-B006-08 carries 'OpenAI Python SDK' in its question but not in its critical strings, and the owner approved it. Implemented as preregistered rather than loosened; recorded so the reviewer can decide whether batch 007 should hold to the stricter rule.
finding_for_reviewer.status: recorded as a passing test, not tuned away

calibration_pilot.status: BLOCKED — the frozen evidence the pilot must draw from is not present in this environment

why.finding: the NO_BUILDER/UNBUILDABLE set was counted, never persisted
why.evidence: batch 006 recorded removed.unbuildable = 2482 as an integer; scripts/export_batch_006.py:733 increments the counter and returns, discarding the fact's identity. No artifact records which spans they were.

why.finding: the corpus text exists only in Postgres, and this container has no corpus
why.evidence: load_docs() reads document_version.normalized_text joined to corpus_snapshot_version. The local cluster starts but holds only postgres/template0/template1 — there is no 'rag' database and no snapshot.

why.finding: the raw documents are not in the repository
why.evidence: data/raw/ contains only .gitkeep and is gitignored by design; data/cache/ is empty.

why.finding: re-fetching would not reproduce the frozen snapshot
why.evidence: data/manifests/v1-openai-anthropic.yaml lists 202 documents captured 2026-08-17 with no text and no content hashes. Re-fetching returns the documentation as it stands today, so offsets and evidence hashes would not match snap_689e336380a054d8039dc35b2c09cd0a, and the evidence would not be the frozen evidence.

calibration_pilot.what_was_not_done_and_why: No pilot case was authored. Authoring 10 cases against invented or re-fetched evidence would produce exactly what the preregistration exists to prevent — a benchmark testing what its author imagined rather than what the documentation says — and the pilot's four thresholds would measure nothing.
calibration_pilot.to_unblock: Restore the corpus snapshot into Postgres (or restore data/raw/ and re-ingest), then re-run batch 006's miners to re-derive the spans that reach no builder and take the pilot's 10 from that set.

next_step: Independent review of the three fixes, and a decision on the G-STRICTER finding, before the corpus is restored and the pilot is run. The paraphrasing lane does not scale until the pilot passes.
